     6  module

    10  public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Unramified.Basic
    11  
    12  /-!
    13  
    14  # Étale morphisms
    15  
    16  An `R`-algebra `A` is formally etale if `Ω[A⁄R]` and `H¹(L_{A/R})` both vanish.
    17  This is equivalent to the standard definition that "for every `R`-algebra `B`,
    18  every square-zero ideal `I : Ideal B` and `f : A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I`, there exists
    19  exactly one lift `A →ₐ[R] B`".
    20  An `R`-algebra `A` is étale if it is formally étale and of finite presentation.
    21  
    22  We show that the property extends onto nilpotent ideals, and that these properties are stable
    23  under `R`-algebra homomorphisms and compositions.
    24  
    25  We show that étale is stable under algebra isomorphisms, composition and
    26  localization at an element.
    27  
    28  -/
    29  
    30  @[expose] public section
    31  
    32  open scoped TensorProduct
    33  
    34  universe u v
    35  
    36  namespace Algebra
    37  
    38  variable {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    39    [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    40  
    41  section
    42  
    43  variable (R A) in
    44  /-- An `R`-algebra `A` is formally etale if both `Ω[A⁄R]` and `H¹(L_{A/R})` are zero.
    45  For the infinitesimal lifting definition, see `FormallyEtale.iff_comp_bijective`. -/
    46  @[mk_iff, stacks 00UQ]
    47  class FormallyEtale : Prop where
    48    subsingleton_kaehlerDifferential : Subsingleton Ω[A⁄R]
    49    subsingleton_h1Cotangent : Subsingleton (H1Cotangent R A)
    50  
    51  attribute [instance]
    52    FormallyEtale.subsingleton_kaehlerDifferential FormallyEtale.subsingleton_h1Cotangent
    53  
    54  end
    55  
    56  namespace FormallyEtale
    57  
    58  section
    59  
    60  instance (priority := 100) [FormallyEtale R A] :
    61      FormallyUnramified R A := ⟨inferInstance⟩
    62  
    63  instance (priority := 100) [FormallyEtale R A] : FormallySmooth R A :=
    64    ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    65  
    66  theorem iff_formallyUnramified_and_formallySmooth :
    67      FormallyEtale R A ↔ FormallyUnramified R A ∧ FormallySmooth R A :=
    68    ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩⟩
